title: Verified Deep Learning with Lean 4
description: A formal verification of the math of modern deep learning, written as a Lean 4 blueprint project and shipped as the code it proves. Mathlib's fderiv is the foundation; every layer's backward is derived as a vector-Jacobian product rather than asserted -- dense, ReLU, softmax cross-entropy, 2D convolution, max-pool, BatchNorm's three-term backward, residual and bottleneck blocks, depthwise and inverted residuals, squeeze-excitation, MobileNetV4's universal inverted bottleneck, LayerNorm, and a 27-theorem treatment of multi-head self-attention -- and composed up to whole-network VJPs. Nine chapters climb from a linear classifier on MNIST to the Vision Transformer; four more put the same primitives to work: a kit of bestiary blocks, the chapter nets on detection, classification and segmentation tasks, generation and the sciences, and game theory. Each chapter's network is a Lean 4 NetSpec whose train step -- forward, loss, backward and optimizer in one StableHLO graph -- is rendered from the proofs, with every parameter update tied to the certified gradient at the denotational level, for all seven networks (ResNet-34, ResNet-50, MobileNetV2, MobileNetV4-Conv-M, EfficientNet-B0, ConvNeXt-T, ViT-Tiny) at the artifact that trains. The rendered graphs train end to end through XLA/PJRT, with IREE as a second, independent lowerer for the differential oracle against a parallel JAX pipeline, in four tiers: MNIST, CIFAR-10, Imagenette and full ImageNet-1k, where every pair trains its paper's recipe on both paths and the verified path lands within two tenths of its JAX reference on the seven chapter pairs (ResNet-50 at 77.99% top-1 on RSB-A3, ConvNeXt-T at 82.15%), with the MobileNetV4-Conv-M side quest at 80.05%, a quarter of a point ahead of its own. Demos extend the same stack, in the book's order, to drone-view and industrial object detection, sign-language and leaf-disease classification under honest splits, multispectral land cover across continents, brain-tumor segmentation, a character-level language model, diffusion, low-dose CT synthesis held out on a second scanner, a flow-matching Boltzmann generator, gravitational-wave detection on LIGO strain against the matched filter, a transformer wavefunction for the Ising chain, a distogram ResNet against the CASP16 field, and four games scored against exact answers: DQN on Pong, Deep CFR on poker, AlphaZero and MuZero on tic-tac-toe. The proof suite contains zero project axioms; every theorem closes under exactly {propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice}, with 110 headline theorems independently kernel-rechecked by leanprover/comparator. Builds on the architectural coverage of 'Convolutional Neural Networks with Swift for TensorFlow' (Apress, 2021), extending through ConvNeXt and ViT and adding formal proofs throughout.
